What we work on

Every engagement starts from your real numbers, not a template.

  • Cash runway review

    How many months your cash covers, what shortens it, and the three moves that lengthen it.

  • Pricing review

  • Monthly numbers review

    Five numbers on one page by the tenth of every month, and a call to read them together.

    Price it

    Your books arranged so the monthly report builds itself instead of eating a weekend.

    Price it

  • Hiring plan

    What the next hire costs fully loaded, what they must cover, and when you can afford them.

    Price it

  • Sales process

    Every quote tracked from first call to yes or no, so you see where jobs slip away.

    Price it

    Projections and a written plan built from your real numbers, ready for the bank meeting.
